newsitem.title: USA: AOL hardwire fault snags service for 45 mins.
newsitem.headline: AOL hardwire fault snags service for 45 mins.

text.p: A hardware problem at America Online Inc interrupted service for some users for about 45 minutes Wednesday evening.

AOL spokeswoman Tricia Primrose said the problem began about 1700 EDT/2100GMT and kept some customers from logging onto the online service. Users who were already logged in at the time the problem began were unaffected, she added.
Primrose said the problem was sporadic throughout AOL's nationwide network, but she said she did not know how many customers were affected.
"It was a log in problem that started at five and that lasted a short duration. Nobody who was on the system was impacted, and it was completely resolved by 5:45," Primrose said.
